name: jot
title: Jot
description: Search, add, and capture jots in Jot, the quick capture app for Mac: voice notes, quick draw, screen annotation, images and sections. Needs the Jot app.
author: mohak_bajaj

commands.name: search-jots
commands.title: Search Jots
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Search open jots, then open, copy, finish, archive, or tag them.

commands.name: add-jot
commands.title: Add Jot
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Write a new jot in Markdown, with optional tags.

commands.name: quick-jot
commands.title: Quick Jot
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Add a jot straight from the Raycast bar. End with #tags to tag it.

arguments.name: text
arguments.placeholder: What's on Your Mind? End with #tags

commands.name: voice-note
commands.title: Voice Note
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Speak a jot. Opens Jot's voice note, transcribed on your Mac.

commands.name: quick-draw
commands.title: Quick Draw
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Sketch something and save it as a jot.

commands.name: annotate-screen
commands.title: Annotate Screen
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Grab a region of the screen and mark it up.

commands.name: quick-note
commands.title: Quick Note
commands.subtitle: Jot
commands.description: Open Jot's quick note window over any app.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Jot CLI
preferences.description: Path to the jot CLI. Leave empty to use /usr/local/bin/jot or /Applications/Jot.app/Contents/Helpers/jot.

preferences.name: vault
preferences.title: Vault Folder
preferences.description: Vault folder to use. Leave empty to use the vault from Jot settings.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
